lessons: The premise does not hold. notify_command (serve_rig.py:298) only writes a notify argv into config via amend_config. It never runs the command, so it needs no dispatch from FakeExec. Move it to tests/loop_helpers.py and keep its signature. Do not edit tests/fakes.py.

Replace the sys.executable '-c' script with a fixed in-process argv such as ['notify'], or None when enabled=False. FakeExec.run (tests/fakes.py:35) records that argv in .calls and returns its fixed result, which is all 'run through FakeExec' requires.

The only consumer, tests/integration/test_serve_notify.py, is skipped (pytestmark disk_io_skip, line 33). Scope out says skipped importers may break semantically and their batch ticket fixes that. So deliveries.jsonl and notify-fails behavior need not survive this ticket.

In tests/unit/test_loop_helpers.py, test notify_command by writing config under tmp_path. Assert that the notify key holds the in-process argv, and holds None when enabled=False. Do not assert deliveries.
Continue the remaining Scope in work from main: the 26 moved names, the hub import-backs, the 48 importer import lines, and the base vs candidate integration pass/skip counts in run.md (criterion 5).
